GIS Developer/Analyst
Contract
Company Description

Position: GIS Developer/Analyst.

Requisition ID : SAIC CoM 2017 –MC R214157.

Client: City of Memphis(State of TN).

Duration: 3+ Years

JOB PURPOSE AND SUMMARY

The GIS Analyst/Developer under the direction of the GIS Program Manager is responsible for performing the assigned technical tasks in supporting the project initiative for developing a work order/asset management solution that leverages the capabilities of ArcGIS Server and ArcGIS Online suite of tools.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

• Provide the GIS services via Desktop ESRI ArcGIS software to support the City’s web-based GIS applications’ base maps and geoprocessing services

• Provide service for GIS geodatabase editing, data creation and maintenance for applications and for city divisions as needed.

• Be able to work with various city divisions in ascertaining work flows, business requirements and training personnel in the use of GIS technology solutions.

• Data capturing and conversion of GIS data for all GIS activities

• Perform complex GIS analyses with a variety of data formats, Shape Files, Personal

Geodatabases, Third Party data sources (Oracle, SQL Server, Excel, Access, etc.), images

• Work as part of the GIS team to develop distributed products via web-based technology and desktop software

• Expert utilization of the entire suite of ESRI GIS software including extensions (Network

Analyst, Spatial Analyst, etc.) to perform high-level analysis to support various mapping projects and web-based applications

• Expert in performing Python Scripting and Model Builder services needed for support of the City’s web-based applications

• Expert utilization of ArcGIS Server management tools to deploy and manage map and web

services.

• Provide expert utilization of ArcGIS Online technologies to develop applications

• Provide some application development utilizing various programming languages

• Provide development of SOAP and REST Web Services.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s Degree in GIS, Geography, Engineering, Computer Science, Planning or other related field.

• 3 -4 years professional working experience in GIS techniques and methodologies

• Expertise in ESRI software including ArcGIS/ArcInfo.

• Experience with ArcGIS Server management tools

• Working Experience with ArcGIS Online suite of tools

• Working Experience in writing and utilizing Phython Scripting language and Model Builder

• Working knowledge of C#,.NET, HTML, JavaScript

• Windows Operating Systems environment experience

• Knowledge of industry standard data models for municipal government agencies

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
